import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import norm
def task_func(n_samples=1000, mu=0, sigma=1, random_seed=0):
    np.random.seed(random_seed)
    samples = np.random.normal(loc=mu, scale=sigma, size=n_samples)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(samples, bins=30, density=True, alpha=0.6)
    xmin, xmax = ax.get_xlim()
    x = np.linspace(xmin, xmax, 200)
    ax.plot(x, norm.pdf(x, mu, sigma), 'r', linewidth=2)
    return ax, samples
